config firewall policy
    edit 240024
        set status disable
        set name "NETOPS-FIREWALL-COMMIT-POLICY"
        set uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a3
        set srcintf "netops-ipsec"
        set dstintf "ipsec-status-lo"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "NETOPS-FIREWALL-COMMIT-GROUP"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL_TCP"
        set logtraffic all
    next
end
